messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to finalize the 'radar' launch tradeoffs. customer-alpha asked for per-route cost breakdown in the console + tracing hooks for tail latency + error analytics. Can we map out acceptance gates and what to cut if timelines slip? :eyes:
aj: Short answer: we can deliver a lightweight cost slice + basic trace hooks by EOW next sprint, full per-route billing will take longer (depends on routing metadata).
frank: Agree with aj. Perf team: main unknown is overhead of trace hooks at p95 under current batching. If hooks add >5% latency we should gate.
denise: Customer asks: "we need cost split by model, route, and dataset" — the minimal MVP for them is model+route. dataset-level is nice-to-have.
samira: For the console UX: can we show a sampled per-route cost number with clear confidence intervals? That buys time on full accuracy.
elena: Ops question: what sampling rate do we need to estimate per-route cost within 10%? I ran a quick sim — with 1% sampling we get noisy numbers for low-volume routes. Recommend adaptive sampling.
maya: Good — proposal: MVP-1 (launch slice):
```
- Dashboard: route + model cost estimates (sampled) with CI
- Tracing hooks: span tags for route_id, model_id, quant_profile
- Error analytics: top-5 error-signatures by route (rolling 24h)
- Launch gate: p95 latency regression <5% vs baseline and cost estimator within 20% for top 80% traffic
```
If we fail gate, fallback to: disable detailed traces but keep cost estimator in heuristics mode.
aj: Implementation notes: tracing hooks require small schema change — add route_id to span root and propagate into dataplane. Minimal server-side index needed for error signature aggregation.
frank: Runbook item: measure added token-processing time per-hook. If overhead > 3us/token we should consider sampling traces at 0.5% for non-critical routes.
denise: Customer beta: want canary in their dedicated region first. That means we need private deployment compatibility (no extra telemetry leaks). Samira — is the console UI ready for a region-based toggle?
samira: Yes, we can gate widgets by region flag. Need a tiny API change to request per-region aggregates (already in infra backlog).
elena: Cost estimator design: combine billable token counts + model latency multipliers + infra-unit cost. That gives per-route estimated dollars. Will need monthly job to reconcile estimates vs actual invoice.
maya: Acceptance criteria (short):
- Show per-route cost estimates in console for beta customer (sampled, CI)
- Traces emit route_id + model metadata for canary region only
- Error analytics surface top-5 signatures and link to traces
- No SLA regressions for canary customers (p95 latency within 5%)
- Telemetry/PII check passed (security signoff)

denise: Timeline request from customer: wants beta in 3 weeks. Realistic?
aj: Tight. MVP-1 doable in 3 wks if we focus on sampling and region flag. Full per-route billing reconciliation needs 2–3 months.
frank: Heads up: runtime team has a GPU kernel rollout next week — could affect baseline latency numbers. We should freeze baseline at current commit and rerun p95 after their rollout.
infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime-kernels v2.14 -> production in 48h. Rolling over 6 regions.
maya: Ok — action items:
- aj: spec minimal schema change and PR for route_id propagation (due in 3 days)
- frank: perf microbench + threshold eval (due in 6 days)
- samira: console flag + placeholder UI mock (due in 5 days)
- elena: sampling plan + estimator prototype (due in 7 days)
- denise: confirm beta customer region and legal constraints (today)
- maya: coordinate security signoff and acceptance test plan (due in 10 days)

samira: UI note — we'll show a small badge "sampled" and a link to explain method. Keeps customers honest. :ok_hand:
frank: If the perf hit is >5% at p95 we fallback to showing cost estimates without traces (still useful).
denise: I'll message customer-alpha that 3 weeks is target for beta, caveat on trace fidelity and dataset-level breakdown.
maya: Thanks. If everyone can ack the action items here we'll lock the plan.
aj: ack
frank: ack
denise: ack
samira: ack
elena: ack
infra-bot: Noted. Will post post-deploy perf metrics in #eng-runtime once rollout completes.
maya: Closing loop — next check-in in 48h after kernel rollout. If anything blocks earlier ping me directly. :pray:
